candidate_evidence.quote: Synergistic Treatment With Antiretrovirals and Laser Interstitial Thermal thErapy (STARLITE) for Unresectable High-Grade Gliomas

On Day 7, participants will begin combination antiretroviral therapy (ART) consisting of Abacavir, Lamivudine, and dose escalation/de-escalation of Ritonavir (RTV), to determine the recommended Phase 2 dose (RP2D) of Ritonavir.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: newly diagnosed high-grade glioma(s) that cannot be removed surgically

role_evidence.quote: Participants will take one 600mg tablet of Abacavir orally once daily, as part of combination antiretroviral therapy (ART).
Participants will take one 300mg tablet of Lamivudine orally once daily, as part of combination antiretroviral therapy (ART)
dose escalation/de-escalation of Ritonavir (RTV), to determine the recommended Phase 2 dose (RP2D) of Ritonavir
as part of standard of care adjuvant therapy

coder_notes: Only 'high-grade glioma' is named (conditions, title, eligibility); glioblastoma is not named, so screening fails at S5. Antiretroviral combination (abacavir, lamivudine, ritonavir) treated as three investigational agents (title: synergistic treatment with antiretrovirals); ritonavir is dose-escalated as a study drug, not described as a PK booster. LITT is a procedure, not an agent, and is paired with the drugs as an ablation, not as drug delivery/activation, so device_dependent false. HLA-B*5701 is a germline safety marker and is not coded.
